sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one claim about tomorrow made in eight rooms: a clinic, a harbour, a temple, a newsroom, a bank, a pulpit, a letter and a stadium.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个关于明天的主张，说在八个房间里：诊所、港口、神庙、新闻室、银行、讲坛、一封信与一座球场。

core.en: READING A LETTER THAT HAS NOT ARRIVED

branches.en: A body and a sky, both read for what comes next.
branches.cn: 被读来推测下一步的身体与天空。

branches.en: An omen and its interpreter.
branches.cn: 一个征兆与它的解读者。

branches.en: An election and a balance sheet.
branches.cn: 一场选举与一份资产负债表。

branches.en: The pompous voice and the doom it enjoys.
branches.cn: 浮夸的嗓音与它乐在其中的灾祸。

branches.en: The one place with a scoreboard.
branches.cn: 唯一有记分牌的地方。

intro.en: The gnosis family is about knowing: diagnosis knows through, prognosis knows before, and agnostic admits it does not know.
intro.cn: gnosis 词族关乎知道：diagnosis 是透过症状知道，prognosis 是提前知道，agnostic 则承认自己不知道。

latinIntro.en: Greek gignoskein supplies the knowing, and the prefixes dia-, pro- and a- decide whether the knowing goes through, forward or nowhere.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 gignoskein 提供「知道」，前缀 dia-、pro- 与 a- 决定这份知道是穿过、向前，还是根本不到。

items.meaning: of the work of telling apart

items.exampleCN: 一个安静的不可知论者。

definition_zh: 无产者；无产阶级的
definition_en: of the class that lives by selling its labour, or a person belonging to it
core_image: 一排工装挂在钉子上，每件都沾着同一种尘土
scene: 他写的是码头上扛包的人，称他们为无产者。He wrote about the men who carried loads on the docks and called them the proletarian class.
sceneCN: 这里 proletarian 指无产者（第 2 个义项：产业工人）；句意为写的是码头上扛包的人，把他们称作无产阶级。

senses.title: Marxist class
senses.definition: the class that owns no capital and lives by selling labour
senses.definitionCN: 不拥有资本、靠出卖劳动力生活的阶级
senses.example: The manifesto addressed the proletarian as the coming majority.
senses.exampleCN: 宣言把无产者当作即将成为多数的群体来呼唤。
senses.why: The word's modern meaning is built here, in a theory of classes.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的现代含义就建在这里，建在一套阶级理论里。

senses.title: Industrial worker
senses.definition: a person who works with machines in a factory or a dock
senses.definitionCN: 在工厂或码头与机器一同劳作的人
senses.example: He wrote about the men who carried loads on the docks and called them the proletarian class.
senses.exampleCN: 他写码头上扛包的人，称他们为无产阶级。
senses.why: The concrete figure is older than the theory that named him.
senses.whyCN: 具体的人比命名他的理论更古老。

senses.title: Proletarian culture
senses.definition: art and writing made for, by or about the working class
senses.definitionCN: 为工人阶级而作、由工人阶级所作或写工人阶级的艺术
senses.example: The posters were the visual language of proletarian culture.
senses.exampleCN: 那些海报是无产阶级文化的视觉语言。
senses.why: Culture claims the word when politics has already used it.
senses.whyCN: 政治用过之后，文化才来认领这个词。

senses.title: Proletarian literature
senses.definition: fiction that takes the worker's life as its subject and its audience
senses.definitionCN: 以工人生活为题材与读者的文学
senses.example: The novel is read as proletarian literature, though its hero is a clerk.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说被读作无产阶级文学，尽管主人公是个职员。
senses.why: The label is applied by critics as often as by authors.
senses.whyCN: 这个标签由批评家贴上的次数，和作者自己贴的一样多。

senses.title: Proletarian district
senses.definition: a neighbourhood built for wage-earners, usually near works or rails
senses.definitionCN: 为挣工资的人建的街区，通常靠近工厂或铁路
senses.example: The proletarian district grew on the wrong side of the tracks.
senses.exampleCN: 工人街区在铁轨错误的一侧生长起来。
senses.why: Cities keep the word for the map of labour.
senses.whyCN: 城市用这个词记下劳动力的地图。

senses.title: As an adjective
senses.definition: used before a noun to mark it as belonging to the working class
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，标示它属于工人阶级
senses.example: His proletarian accent closed two doors and opened one.
senses.exampleCN: 他那口无产者的口音关上了两扇门，又打开了一扇。
senses.why: The adjective can describe a coat, an accent or a habit.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词可以形容一件外套、一种口音或一个习惯。

senses.title: Against 'the poor'
senses.definition: a class defined by the sale of labour rather than by lack of money
senses.definitionCN: 按出卖劳动力、而非按缺钱来界定的阶级
senses.example: A proletarian is not simply a poor man; he has a wage and a workplace.
senses.exampleCN: 无产者不只是穷人；他有工资，也有工作场所。
senses.why: The word is economic before it is sympathetic.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先是经济的，然后才是同情的。

senses.title: Class identity
senses.definition: a self-description adopted by people who claim the class as their own
senses.definitionCN: 把这阶级认作自己所属的自我描述
senses.example: He called himself proletarian long after he had bought the factory.
senses.exampleCN: 他买下工厂很久之后，仍称自己为无产者。
senses.why: Identity can outlive the conditions that made it.
senses.whyCN: 身份可以比造就它的处境活得更久。

intro.en: Proletarian comes from the Latin word for offspring: the lowest class counted for nothing but the children it produced.
intro.cn: proletarian 来自拉丁语的「后代」：最底层阶级唯一被计入的贡献，就是他们生下的孩子。

items.en: Proles meant 'offspring', the children a family could add to the state.
items.cn: proles 意为「后代」，即一个家庭能为国家添的孩子。

items.en: Proletarius named the citizen whose only gift to Rome was his children.
items.cn: proletarius 指那个唯一献给罗马的东西是孩子的公民。

items.en: The census ranked him below the classes that paid tax or served with arms.
items.cn: 户籍把他排在纳税或服兵役的阶级之下。

items.en: Nineteenth-century political economy turned the Roman insult into a class with a future.
items.cn: 十九世纪政治经济学把罗马的轻蔑变成一个拥有未来的阶级。

items.en: Today the word is either analytical or nostalgic, and it rarely sounds neutral.
items.cn: 今天这个词要么是分析性的，要么是怀旧的，很少听起来中性。

note.en: The look-alike group is the proles family; the near-meaning group separates working-class, wage-earner, plebeian and labourer.
note.cn: 形近组是 proles 词族；近义组把「工人阶级的」「挣工资者」「平民」与「劳动者」分开。

entries.definition: the working class as a whole.
of people who work for wages.
of the common people, often dismissively.
one who does heavy manual work.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a row of work coats on pegs, all dusted with the same colour.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一排挂在钉子上的工装，沾着同一种尘土」的画面。

normal.en: Proletarian holds proles, Latin for offspring: the class valued only for its children.
normal.cn: proletarian 里藏着 proles（拉丁语的后代）：这个阶级只被按孩子来估价。

normal.en: Think of a row of work coats, all dusted with the same colour.
normal.cn: 想象一排工装，都沾着同一种尘土。

normal.en: Pro-le-TAIR-i-an: the stress sits on tair, where the class name lands.
normal.cn: pro-le-TAIR-i-an：重音落在 tair，阶级名称正落在那里。

normal.en: Say pro-luh-TAIR-ee-uhn; the long tail makes the word sound like a category.
normal.cn: 读成 pro-luh-TAIR-ee-uhn，长长的词尾让它听起来像一个分类。

normal.en: Pair it with proletariat: one is a person, the other is the whole class.
normal.cn: 把它和 proletariat 配对：一个是人，一个是整个阶级。

abstract.en: The word began as a census joke about children and became a theory about work.
abstract.cn: 这个词起初是关于孩子的户籍笑话，后来成了关于劳动的理论。

abstract.en: Proletarian is defined by what it sells, not by what it lacks, which is why it is not a synonym for poor.
abstract.cn: 无产者按它卖什么来定义，不按它缺什么来定义，所以它并非穷人的同义词。

abstract.en: A label can be worn with pride or with irony, and the word allows both.
abstract.cn: 标签可以带着骄傲或反讽来戴，这个词两者都容许。

examples.en: He called the dock workers the proletarian class.
examples.cn: 他把码头工人称作无产阶级。

examples.en: The posters were the visual language of proletarian culture.
examples.cn: 那些海报是无产阶级文化的视觉语言。

examples.en: A proletarian is not simply a poor man; he has a wage and a workplace.
examples.cn: 无产者不只是穷人；他有工资，也有工作场所。

dict_mnemonic.text: proles（后代）+ arian：只以孩子贡献国家的底层人，后来指「无产者」。

root: 拉丁语 proles（后代）派生的 proletarius，指罗马户籍中最低一等的公民

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one class seen as theory, as bodies, as culture, as literature, as a district, as an adjective, as a contrast and as a self-description.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个阶级的八个看法：作为理论、作为身体、作为文化、作为文学、作为一个街区、作为一个形容词、作为一个对照与作为一种自我描述。

core.en: A ROW OF WORK COATS ON PEGS

branches.en: The theoretical class and its difference from the poor.
branches.cn: 理论上的阶级，以及它与穷人的差别。

branches.en: The worker at the dock.
branches.cn: 码头上的工人。

branches.en: Culture, literature and a district.
branches.cn: 文化、文学与一个街区。

branches.en: The adjective in front of a coat or an accent.
branches.cn: 外套或口音前面的那个形容词。

branches.en: The label people choose for themselves.
branches.cn: 人们为自己选择的标签。

intro.en: The proles family is about a class: proletarian is the person, proletariat is the whole, proletarianize is what industry does to a town.
intro.cn: proles 词族关乎一个阶级：proletarian 是人，proletariat 是整体，proletarianize 是工业对一座镇所做的事。

latinIntro.en: Latin proles supplies the offspring, and the endings -arius and -atus turn a census category into a person and then a mass.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 proles 提供后代，词尾 -arius 与 -atus 把一个户籍类别先变成一个人，再变成一片人群。

items.meaning: the process of becoming a wage class

definition_zh: 禁止；查禁；放逐；公开谴责；判为不规范
definition_en: to forbid something by authority, to name a person or practice as outside the law, or to condemn a usage as incorrect
core_image: 一张公告贴在城门上，某个名字被写在最上面
scene: 新规一公布，那种添加剂就被禁止使用。The new rules proscribed the additive, and it disappeared from every label within a month.
sceneCN: 这里 proscribe 指明令禁止（第 1 个义项：明令禁止）；句意为新规一公布，那种添加剂就被禁止使用，一个月内从所有标签上消失。

pos.zh: 禁止；查禁；放逐；公开谴责；判为不规范

senses.title: Officially forbid
senses.definition: to forbid a thing by public authority
senses.definitionCN: 由公共权威禁止某样东西
senses.example: The new rules proscribed the additive.
senses.exampleCN: 新规禁止了那种添加剂。
senses.why: The word names the act of writing a ban, not the feeling behind it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名写下禁令的动作，不是禁令背后的情绪。

senses.title: Ban a book
senses.definition: to name a text as forbidden to print or to read
senses.definitionCN: 宣布某文本不得印刷或阅读
senses.example: The index proscribed the book for two centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 那份索引把这本书查禁了两个世纪。
senses.why: Banned things leave a record, which is how we know they were banned.
senses.whyCN: 被禁的东西会留下记录，我们正是靠它知道它们被禁过。

senses.title: Banish a person
senses.definition: to name a person as an outlaw outside the protection of the state
senses.definitionCN: 宣布某人为不受国家保护的法外之人
senses.example: The senate proscribed three families and took their estates.
senses.exampleCN: 元老院放逐了三个家族，还没收了他们的产业。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, and the most physical.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，也是最物理的一个。

senses.title: Condemn publicly
senses.definition: to declare a person or a view as shameful in public
senses.definitionCN: 公开宣布某人或某观点是可耻的
senses.example: The sermon proscribed the whole idea as a heresy.
senses.exampleCN: 那场布道把整个想法公开斥为异端。
senses.why: The word can act without any court behind it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以在没有任何法庭支持的情况下行动。

senses.title: Proscribed usage
senses.definition: of a word or a construction, condemned by usage guides rather than by any court
senses.definitionCN: 指词语或句式被用法指南判为不规范，而非被法庭禁止
senses.example: The old guide proscribes the split infinitive, and good writers ignore it.
senses.exampleCN: 那本旧指南把分裂不定式判为不规范，好作家却照用不误。
senses.why: Here the authority is a stylebook, and the only penalty is a raised eyebrow.
senses.whyCN: 这里权威只是一本格式手册，唯一的惩罚是别人挑眉。

intro.en: Proscribe is a writing word: to proscribe was to publish a name on a list that put it outside the law.
intro.cn: proscribe 是一个「写」的词：proscribe 原指把一个名字写进名单，使它落到法律之外。

items.en: Scribere meant 'to write', the verb behind scribe, script and describe.
items.cn: scribere 意为「写」，是 scribe、script 与 describe 背后的动词。

items.en: Proscribere meant 'to write up in public', especially a name for sale or for death.
items.cn: proscribere 意为「公开写出」，尤指写出供拍卖或处死的名字。

items.en: Sulla's proscriptions were lists posted in the forum, and the word never lost the notice board.
items.cn: 苏拉的放逐名单就贴在广场上，这个词再没丢掉那块公告板。

items.en: English borrowed proscribe first for outlawry and later for any ban.
items.cn: 英语最初借 proscribe 指剥夺法律保护，后泛指禁止。

items.en: Today laws, agencies and treaties all proscribe things, and the pen is metaphorical.
items.cn: 今天法律、机构与条约都在 proscribe 某些东西，那支笔已经是比喻。

note.en: The look-alike group is the scribere family; the near-meaning group separates forbid, prohibit, outlaw and ban.
note.cn: 形近组是 scribere 词族；近义组把「禁止」「阻止」「宣布非法」与「取缔」分开。

entries.definition: to order or recommend a course.
the act of forbidding or outlawing.
to order that something not be done.
to forbid by rule or law.
to declare illegal or outside protection.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a public notice with one name written at the top.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一张公告，最上面写着一个名字」的画面。

normal.en: Proscribe holds scribere, to write: a ban is a name written where everyone can read it.
normal.cn: proscribe 里藏着 scribere（写）：禁令就是一个写给大家看的名字。

normal.en: Think of a list posted in a forum, and a family packing before dawn.
normal.cn: 想象广场上贴着一张名单，一户人家在天亮前收拾行李。

normal.en: Pro-SCRIBE: the stress sits on scribe, where the writing happens.
normal.cn: pro-SCRIBE：重音落在 scribe，正是书写发生处。

normal.en: Say pruh-SKRYB; the second syllable rhymes with the act of writing.
normal.cn: 读成 pruh-SKRYB，第二音节与「写」这个动作押韵。

normal.en: Pair it with prescribe: one writes what must be done, the other what must not.
normal.cn: 把它和 prescribe 配对：一个写下必须做的，另一个写下不许做的。

abstract.en: A proscription is always a document, which is why it can be read, appealed and remembered.
abstract.cn: 禁令始终是一份文书，所以它可被阅读、申诉与记住。

abstract.en: The word moves easily from a person to a practice to a substance, because power always needs a list.
abstract.cn: 这个词轻易地从人移到做法再移到物质，因为权力总需要一张清单。

abstract.en: To proscribe is to decide in advance that an argument will not be heard.
abstract.cn: 宣布禁止，就是提前决定某个论证不会被听见。

examples.en: The new rules proscribed the additive within a month.
examples.cn: 新规在一个月内禁止了那种添加剂。

examples.en: The city proscribed betting in every form but the lottery.
examples.cn: 这座城市禁止一切形式的赌博，只留彩票。

examples.en: The old guide proscribes the split infinitive, and good writers ignore it.
examples.cn: 那本旧指南把分裂不定式判为不规范，好作家却照用不误。

dict_mnemonic.text: pro（在前）+ scribe（写）：把名字写在公告上，就是「查禁、放逐」。

root: 拉丁语 proscribere（公开写出），由 pro-（在前、公开）与 scribere（写）构成

sensesIntro.en: The five senses move from a rule to a text, a person, a reputation and a grammar: forbid, censor, outlaw, denounce and mark a usage wrong.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项从一条规则移到一本书、一个人、一个名声和一条语法：禁止、查禁、放逐、谴责，以及把一种用法判为不规范。

core.en: A PUBLIC LIST WITH ONE NAME AT THE TOP
core.cn: 一张最上面写着名字的公告

branches.en: A rule and a text, both put outside the line.
branches.cn: 被放到线外的规则与文本。

branches.en: A person named out of the state's protection.
branches.cn: 被点名失去国家保护的人。

branches.en: A view denounced with no court behind it.
branches.cn: 没有法庭支持就遭谴责的观点。

branches.en: A usage convicted by a stylebook.
branches.cn: 被格式手册定罪的用法。

branches.en: One pen at work on things and on people.
branches.cn: 同一支笔作用于物，也作用于人。

intro.en: The scribere family is about writing: describe writes down, prescribe writes first, proscribe writes against, and a script is what is written.
intro.cn: scribere 词族关乎书写：describe 写下，prescribe 先写，proscribe 反着写，而 script 是被写下的东西。

latinIntro.en: Latin pro- means forward or in public, and scribere means to write; proscribere is therefore writing something out where all can see it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pro- 意为向前或公开，scribere 意为写；因此 proscribere 就是把某物写到众人可见之处。

items.meaning: the act of naming a ban

definition_zh: 变化多端的；多才多艺的；难以捉摸的
definition_en: changing shape or form easily, like the sea god who could become anything
core_image: 一个人在同一分钟里换掉外套、口音和职业
scene: 他在同一周里当木匠、写剧本、又去修船，像换了一个人。He worked as a carpenter, wrote a play and repaired a boat in the same week, a protean talent that no single title could hold.
sceneCN: 这里 protean 指多才多艺、形态多变（第 2 个义项：多才多艺）；句意为他在同一周里当木匠、写剧本、又修船，这种多变才能没有一个头衔装得下。

pos.zh: 变化多端的；多才多艺的；难以捉摸的

senses.title: Shape-shifting
senses.definition: taking many physical forms, one after another
senses.definitionCN: 接连呈现许多种形体
senses.example: The creature was protean, now fish and now stone.
senses.exampleCN: 那东西形态多变，一会儿是鱼，一会儿是石头。
senses.why: This is the mythic sense: the body itself keeps changing.
senses.whyCN: 这是神话义：身体本身不断改变。

senses.title: Versatile talent
senses.definition: able to do many kinds of work well
senses.definitionCN: 能把许多种活干好
senses.example: No single title could hold his protean talent.
senses.exampleCN: 没有一个头衔装得下他那多变的才能。
senses.why: The word praises range rather than depth.
senses.whyCN: 这个词称赞广度，而不是深度。

senses.title: Changing personality
senses.definition: of a person whose manner changes with the room
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个人的举止随房间而变
senses.example: She was protean in company and silent at home.
senses.exampleCN: 她在人群里多变，在家里沉默。
senses.why: The social sense can be a gift or a warning.
senses.whyCN: 这个社交义项可以是天赋，也可以是警告。

senses.title: Protean disease
senses.definition: of an illness that presents itself differently in different patients
senses.definitionCN: 在不同病人身上表现不同的疾病
senses.example: The disease is protean, and two cases rarely look alike.
senses.exampleCN: 这种病表现多变，两个病例很少长得一样。
senses.why: Medicine borrowed the myth because diagnosis needs a word for variety.
senses.whyCN: 医学借来神话，因为诊断需要一个表示多样的词。

senses.title: Protean career
senses.definition: of a working life that keeps changing field and role
senses.definitionCN: 不断更换领域与角色的职业生涯
senses.example: The protean career replaced the single employer.
senses.exampleCN: 多变职业取代了单一雇主。
senses.why: Modern labour gave an old myth a new address.
senses.whyCN: 现代劳动给一个古老神话换了新地址。

senses.title: Protean idea
senses.definition: of a concept that shifts meaning each time it is used
senses.definitionCN: 每次使用都会改变含义的概念
senses.example: Justice is a protean word in the speeches.
senses.exampleCN: justice 在那些演说里是一个变化不定的词。
senses.why: Ideas can be shape-shifters too, and harder to catch.
senses.whyCN: 观念也会变形，而且更难抓住。

senses.title: Protean artist
senses.definition: of an artist who refuses to stay inside one style
senses.definitionCN: 拒绝停留在一种风格里的艺术家
senses.example: The protean artist changed manner every decade.
senses.exampleCN: 这位多变的艺术家每十年换一种手法。
senses.why: Critics use the word both as praise and as suspicion.
senses.whyCN: 批评家使用这个词时，既是称赞也是怀疑。

senses.title: Elusiveness
senses.definition: of anything that will not hold still long enough to be defined
senses.definitionCN: 任何不肯静止到能被定义的事物
senses.example: The movement's aims were protean and its members disagreed.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动的目标难以捉摸，成员彼此意见不一。
senses.why: Here the word stops praising and starts asking for a definition.
senses.whyCN: 这里这个词不再称赞，开始要求一个定义。

intro.en: Protean is named after Proteus, the sea god who answered questions by turning into anything else.
intro.cn: protean 得名于海神普罗透斯，他靠变成别的东西来回避提问。

items.en: Proteus was an old sea god who knew the future and hated to be asked.
items.cn: 普罗透斯是一位知道未来却讨厌被追问的老海神。

items.en: In the Odyssey Menelaus holds him while he becomes a lion, a snake and a tree.
items.cn: 在《奥德赛》里，墨涅拉俄斯把他抓住，他先后变成狮子、蛇与树。

items.en: English coined protean for anything that could take many shapes.
items.cn: 英语造出 protean，指任何能呈现多种形态的东西。

items.en: Geology used protean for minerals that crystallise in several forms.
items.cn: 地质学用 protean 指能以多种形式结晶的矿物。

items.en: Today it describes talents, careers, diseases and words, all in the same spirit.
items.cn: 今天它形容才能、职业、疾病与词语，都带着同一种精神。

note.en: The look-alike group is the prote- family; the near-meaning group separates mutable, versatile, mercurial and chameleonic.
note.cn: 形近组是 prote- 词族；近义组把「可变的」「多面的」「反复无常的」与「善变的」分开。

entries.definition: a chain of amino acids in living tissue.
the full set of proteins in a cell.
entries.definitionCN: 一个细胞里全部蛋白质。

entries.definition: an enzyme that breaks down proteins.

entries.definitionCN: 随环境改变以相适应的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a man changing coat, accent and trade inside one minute.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一个人在一分钟里换掉外套、口音与行当」的画面。

normal.en: Protean is named for Proteus, the sea god who turned into lion, snake and tree to escape a question.
normal.cn: protean 得名于海神普罗透斯，他为逃避提问变成狮子、蛇与树。

normal.en: Think of one person with three trades and no single business card.
normal.cn: 想象一个人干三行，却没有一张能用的名片。

normal.en: Pro-TE-an: the stress sits on te, and the word keeps moving.
normal.cn: pro-TE-an：重音落在 te，整个词一直在动。

normal.en: Say PROH-tee-uhn; the first syllable is calm, the rest is the change.
normal.cn: 读成 PROH-tee-uhn，第一音节平静，其余部分是变化。

normal.en: Pair it with talent: a protean talent cannot be filed under one heading.
normal.cn: 把它和 talent 配对：多变的才能无法归档在一个标题下。

abstract.en: Protean praise and protean suspicion use the same word, because range and unreliability look alike from outside.
abstract.cn: 多变的称赞与多变的怀疑用同一个词，因为广度与不可靠从外面看是一样的。

abstract.en: A protean thing is hard to define, and hard to hold responsible.
abstract.cn: 多变之物难以定义，也难以被追究责任。

abstract.en: The myth survives because every age has something that will not stay in one shape.
abstract.cn: 这个神话活了下来，因为每个时代都有不肯保持一种形状的东西。

examples.en: He showed a protean talent that no single title could hold.
examples.cn: 他显出多变的才能，没有一个头衔装得下。

examples.en: The disease is protean, and two cases rarely look alike.
examples.cn: 这种病表现多变，两个病例很少长得一样。

examples.en: The protean artist changed manner every decade.
examples.cn: 这位多变的艺术家每十年换一种手法。

dict_mnemonic.text: Proteus（会变形的海神）+ an：像普罗透斯一样什么都能变，就是「变化多端的」。

root: 希腊神话海神普罗透斯（Proteus），荷马史诗中能变成狮、蛇、树以逃避追问

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one shape-shifter in different bodies: a creature, a talent, a personality, a disease, a career, a word, an artist and a movement.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一个变形者换进不同的身体：一只生物、一种才能、一个性格、一种病、一段职业、一个词、一位艺术家与一场运动。

core.en: ONE PERSON, MANY SHAPES

branches.en: The mythic body that keeps changing.
branches.cn: 不断改变的神话身体。

branches.en: Talent and art that refuse one style.
branches.cn: 拒绝单一风格的才能与艺术。

branches.en: A personality and a movement that will not hold still.
branches.cn: 不肯静止的性格与运动。

branches.en: An illness with many faces.
branches.cn: 有许多面孔的疾病。

branches.en: A career and a word that keep changing field.
branches.cn: 不断换领域的职业与词。

intro.en: The prote- family is roughly about first things and forms: protein and proteome come from the Greek for 'first', while protean comes from the god of many shapes.
intro.cn: prote- 词族大致关乎「最初之物」与形态：protein 与 proteome 来自希腊语的「第一」，而 protean 来自那位多形的神。

latinIntro.en: Greek Proteus supplies the shape-changing, and the adjective ending -an turns a god's name into a description anyone can use.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 Proteus 提供变形能力，形容词词尾 -an 把神名变成一个任何人都能用的描述。

definition_zh: 延长；拖延；使迁延
definition_en: to make something last longer than it should, often with no gain
core_image: 一根线被慢慢往外抽，越抽越长，却始终不肯断
scene: 双方都不肯先让步，谈判一拖就是三年。Neither side would move first, and the talks were protracted for three years.
sceneCN: 这里 protract 指把谈判拖长（第 4 个义项：拖延争端）；句意为双方都不肯先让步，谈判就被拖了三年。

senses.title: Prolong length
senses.definition: to make a period longer than it would naturally be
senses.definitionCN: 把一段时间拉得比它本来更长
senses.example: One objection protracted the hearing by an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 一条反对意见把听证会拖长了一小时。
senses.why: The word measures duration, not difficulty.
senses.whyCN: 这个词衡量时长，不衡量难度。

senses.title: Drag out a meeting
senses.definition: to keep a meeting going after its purpose has been served
senses.definitionCN: 会议目的已达到之后仍让它继续
senses.example: The chair protracted the meeting with stories of his own.
senses.exampleCN: 主席用自己的往事把会议拖长。
senses.why: Here the extension has an author and usually a motive.
senses.whyCN: 这里的延长有个施加者，而且通常有动机。

senses.title: Protract an illness
senses.definition: to make a recovery slower by delay or by treatment
senses.definitionCN: 因拖延或处置不当而让康复更慢
senses.example: The infection was protracted by the wrong antibiotic.
senses.exampleCN: 用错了抗生素，感染拖得更久。
senses.why: In medicine the word often carries regret.
senses.whyCN: 在医学里这个词常带着懊悔。

senses.title: Protract a dispute
senses.definition: to keep a conflict open without resolving it
senses.definitionCN: 让冲突一直开着，不予解决
senses.example: Neither side would move first, and the talks were protracted for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 双方都不肯先让步，谈判一拖就是三年。
senses.why: Delay becomes a strategy when both sides prefer the fight.
senses.whyCN: 当双方都更喜欢打，拖延就成了一种策略。

senses.title: Protract pain
senses.definition: to make suffering last beyond its necessary time
senses.definitionCN: 让苦延长到超出必要的时间
senses.example: The appeals protracted the family's grief by a decade.
senses.exampleCN: 一轮轮上诉让这家人的悲伤延长了十年。
senses.why: The word can judge the extension as a cruelty.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以把这种延长判定为残忍。

senses.title: Protracted war
senses.definition: a conflict deliberately kept long by one side or by terrain
senses.definitionCN: 由一方或地形刻意维持很久的战争
senses.example: The marsh turned the campaign into a protracted war.
senses.exampleCN: 沼泽把这场战事变成了持久战。
senses.why: Some things are prolonged on purpose, and the word does not judge.
senses.whyCN: 有些事是被故意拉长的，而这个词并不作评判。

senses.title: Protract a departure
senses.definition: to keep putting off the moment of leaving
senses.definitionCN: 一再推迟离开的那一刻
senses.example: He protracted his departure with one more cup of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 他又添了一杯茶，把离开的时间往后拖。
senses.why: Small delays can be a way of saying something without words.
senses.whyCN: 小小的拖延，可以是一种不用说话的表述。

senses.title: Protract in law
senses.definition: to keep a case alive by procedure rather than by argument
senses.definitionCN: 靠程序而非靠论证把案子拖住
senses.example: The defence protracted the case until the witness died.
senses.exampleCN: 辩方把案子拖到证人去世。
senses.why: Law has a name for delay, and this is it.
senses.whyCN: 法律对拖延有一个称呼，就是这个。

intro.en: Protract is 'to draw forward': the picture is a line pulled out of a pocket, a little longer each time.
intro.cn: protract 就是「向前拉」：画面是一根线从口袋里被拉出来，每次长一点。

items.en: Trahere meant 'to draw or pull', the verb behind tractor, trace and contract.
items.cn: trahere 意为「拉、拖」，是 tractor、trace 与 contract 背后的动词。

items.en: Protrahere meant 'to draw forward or draw out', a plain physical compound.
items.cn: protrahere 意为「向前拉、拉出」，是一个朴素的物理复合词。

items.en: English borrowed protract for stretching time and for drawing lines.
items.cn: 英语借入 protract，既指拉长时间，也指画延长线。

items.en: The instrument protracts a line on paper, and gave geometry a small namesake.
items.cn: 量角器在纸上延长一条线，给几何学留下一个小同名物。

items.en: Today the verb is mostly about time, and its participle is usually an accusation.
items.cn: 今天这个动词多半关乎时间，它的分词通常是一项指责。

note.en: The look-alike group is the trahere family; the near-meaning group separates prolong, extend, drag out and draw out.
note.cn: 形近组是 trahere 词族；近义组把「延长」「延展」「拖长」与「拉长」分开。

entries.definition: drawn out over a long time.
to stretch out in space or time.
to make something last longer than needed.

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a thread pulled slowly out of a pocket.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一根线从口袋里被慢慢拉出」的画面。

normal.en: Protract holds trahere, to pull: the word is a line being drawn out.
normal.cn: protract 里藏着 trahere（拉）：这个词就是一条被拉出来的线。

normal.en: Think of a meeting that could have ended an hour ago.
normal.cn: 想象一场本可一小时前就结束的会议。

normal.en: Pro-TRACT: the stress sits on tract, where the pulling happens.
normal.cn: pro-TRACT：重音落在 tract，正是拉扯发生处。

normal.en: Say pruh-TRAKT; the second syllable sounds like a long hallway.
normal.cn: 读成 pruh-TRAKT，第二音节听起来像一条长走廊。

normal.en: Pair it with protracted: the participle is usually the complaint.
normal.cn: 把它和 protracted 配对：分词形式通常是那句抱怨。

abstract.en: To protract is to buy time with someone else's patience.
abstract.cn: 拖延就是用别人的耐心买时间。

abstract.en: The word does not say why a thing lasts; it only says it lasts longer than it should.
abstract.cn: 这个词不说一件事为何持续，只说它持续得比该有的更久。

abstract.en: Every institution has a procedure for protracting a decision it does not want to make.
abstract.cn: 每个机构都有一套程序，用来拖住一个它不想做的决定。

examples.en: The talks were protracted for three years.
examples.cn: 谈判被拖了三年。

examples.en: One objection protracted the hearing by an hour.
examples.cn: 一条反对意见把听证会拖长了一小时。

examples.en: The defence protracted the case until the witness died.
examples.cn: 辩方把案子拖到证人去世。

dict_mnemonic.text: pro（向前）+ tract（拉）：把时间往前拉，就是「延长、拖延」。

root: 拉丁语 protrahere（向前拉出），由 pro-（向前）与 trahere（拉）构成

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one line pulled longer: a period, a meeting, an illness, a dispute, a grief, a war, a farewell and a lawsuit.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项是同一条被拉长的线：一段时间、一场会议、一次病、一桩争端、一份悲伤、一场战争、一次告别与一宗诉讼。

core.en: A THREAD PULLED OUT OF A POCKET

branches.en: A period and a meeting.
branches.cn: 一段时间与一场会议。

branches.en: An illness made slower.
branches.cn: 被拖慢的病。

branches.en: A dispute and a war.
branches.cn: 争端与战争。

branches.en: A grief and a farewell.
branches.cn: 悲伤与告别。

branches.en: A case kept alive by procedure.
branches.cn: 靠程序拖着不结的案子。

intro.en: The trahere family is about pulling: contract pulls together, extract pulls out, distract pulls aside, protract pulls forward in time.
intro.cn: trahere 词族关乎拉扯：contract 拉到一起，extract 拉出来，distract 拉向旁边，protract 把时间往前拉。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere supplies the pull, and the prefixes con-, ex-, dis- and pro- decide which way the line goes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere 提供那一下拉，前缀 con-、ex-、dis- 与 pro- 决定线往哪边走。

definition_zh: 但书；附加条件；限制性条款
definition_en: a condition attached to an agreement, which must be met before the rest can stand
core_image: 一份合同签了字，最后一页却多出一行小字
scene: 他同意签字，但加了一句：先修好那条路。He agreed to sign, with the proviso that the road be repaired first.
sceneCN: 这里 proviso 指附加条件（第 2 个义项：合同附加条件）；句意为他同意签字，但附加了一个条件，就是先修好那条路。

pos.zh: 但书；附加条件；限制性条款

senses.title: Legal proviso
senses.definition: a clause that limits or exceptions an earlier clause in the same statute
senses.definitionCN: 在同一部法令中限制或豁免前一条款的条文
senses.example: The proviso kept small farms outside the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 那条但书把小农场排除在新规之外。
senses.why: In law the proviso is a structural part, not a footnote.
senses.whyCN: 在法律里，但书是结构部件，不是脚注。

senses.title: Contract condition
senses.definition: a term a party adds before agreeing to the rest
senses.definitionCN: 一方在同意其余条款之前加上的条件
senses.example: He agreed to sign, with the proviso that the road be repaired first.
senses.exampleCN: 他同意签字，条件是先修好那条路。
senses.why: The word marks the price of consent.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标记同意的代价。

senses.title: Treaty reservation
senses.definition: a condition a state attaches to its acceptance of a treaty
senses.definitionCN: 一国在接受条约时附加的条件
senses.example: The signature carried a proviso about coastal waters.
senses.exampleCN: 签字附带了一项关于近海的保留。
senses.why: Diplomacy uses the proviso to agree and disagree at once.
senses.whyCN: 外交用但书同时表达同意与不同意。

senses.title: Debate reservation
senses.definition: a limit a speaker adds to a claim while making it
senses.definitionCN: 说话者在提出主张时同时加上的界限
senses.example: She supported the plan, with the proviso that no jobs be cut.
senses.exampleCN: 她支持这项计划，条件是不得裁员。
senses.why: The word lets a speaker take two positions in one sentence.
senses.whyCN: 这个词让说话者在一句话里站两个位置。

senses.title: With the proviso that
senses.definition: the fixed phrase that introduces the condition in speech
senses.definitionCN: 口语里引出条件的那个固定短语
senses.example: You may borrow it, with the proviso that it comes back on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以借去，条件是周一还回来。
senses.why: The phrase is so common that the noun is rarely heard alone.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语太常用，名词倒很少单独听见。

senses.title: Hidden proviso
senses.definition: a condition buried in a document so that it is missed
senses.definitionCN: 埋在文件里、容易漏看的条件
senses.example: The lease had a proviso about the roof, on page nine.
senses.exampleCN: 租约第九页有一条关于屋顶的但书。
senses.why: The word can carry suspicion when the condition is hard to find.
senses.whyCN: 当条件难以发现时，这个词会带上怀疑。

senses.title: As a safeguard
senses.definition: a limit added to protect someone who would otherwise be exposed
senses.definitionCN: 为保护本会受影响的人而加上的限制
senses.example: The grant came with a proviso that the land stay public.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔拨款附带一项条件：这块地须保持公共所有。
senses.why: Not every proviso is a trick; some are a fence.
senses.whyCN: 并非每条但书都是陷阱；有些是一道围栏。

senses.title: Everyday use
senses.definition: any stated condition before a yes
senses.definitionCN: 任何在答应之前说出的条件
senses.example: I will come, with one proviso: no speeches.
senses.exampleCN: 我会来，有一个前提：别安排发言。
senses.why: The loosest sense has moved far from the courtroom.
senses.whyCN: 最宽松的这个义项，已经离法庭很远了。

intro.en: Proviso is a Latin phrase frozen into a noun: proviso quod meant 'it being provided that'.
intro.cn: proviso 是一个冻成名词的拉丁短语：proviso quod 意为「前提是」。

items.en: Providere meant 'to see ahead, to provide', from videre, to see.
items.cn: providere 意为「预先看见、预备」，来自 videre（看见）。

items.en: The legal phrase proviso quod introduced a condition in medieval documents.
items.cn: 法律短语 proviso quod 在中世纪文书里引出条件。

items.en: English kept the ablative absolute as a noun: a proviso.
items.cn: 英语把这个独立夺格结构留成了名词：a proviso。

items.en: Parliamentary drafters gave the proviso a fixed place in the structure of an act.
items.cn: 议会起草人给但书在法令结构里安排了一个固定位置。

items.en: Today anyone can attach a proviso to a yes, and the courtroom is optional.
items.cn: 今天任何人都能在一个「好」字后面附上但书，法庭并非必需。

note.en: The look-alike group is the providere family; the near-meaning group separates condition, stipulation, caveat and reservation.
note.cn: 形近组是 providere 词族；近义组把「条件」「约定」「提醒性限制」与「保留」分开。

entries.definition: to supply, or to state in a rule.

entries.definitionCN: 在其余之前必须满足之事。

entries.definition: a term demanded in an agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 协议中要求的一项条款。

entries.definition: a warning that limits a claim.
a doubt held back from full agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 未完全同意时保留的疑虑。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a signed page with one extra line at the bottom.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一页已签字的合同，底部多出一行小字」的画面。

normal.en: Proviso is from proviso quod, 'it being provided that': the condition is written in advance.
normal.cn: proviso 来自 proviso quod（前提是）：条件被预先写下。

normal.en: Think of a yes with a small tail attached to it.
normal.cn: 想象一个「好」字后面拖着一条小尾巴。

normal.en: Pro-VI-so: the stress sits on vi, where the seeing ahead happens.
normal.cn: pro-VI-so：重音落在 vi，正是「预先看见」所在。

normal.en: Say pruh-VY-zoh; the middle sound is the eye looking forward.
normal.cn: 读成 pruh-VY-zoh，中间的音就是那只向前看的眼。

normal.en: Pair it with that: 'with the proviso that' is the whole phrase people actually say.
normal.cn: 把它和 that 配对：人们实际说的整句是 with the proviso that。

abstract.en: A proviso is consent with a fence around it.
abstract.cn: 但书是围了栅栏的同意。

abstract.en: The word protects two things at once: the agreement and the person who would be hurt by it.
abstract.cn: 这个词同时保护两样东西：协议，以及会被协议伤到的人。

abstract.en: Every yes that arrives too easily is worth checking for the small line at the bottom.
abstract.cn: 每一个来得太容易的「好」，都值得翻到页面底部找那行小字。

examples.en: He agreed to sign, with the proviso that the road be repaired first.
examples.cn: 他同意签字，条件是先修好那条路。

examples.en: The lease had a proviso about the roof, on page nine.
examples.cn: 租约第九页有一条关于屋顶的但书。

examples.en: I will come, with one proviso: no speeches.
examples.cn: 我会来，有一个前提：别安排发言。

dict_mnemonic.text: pro（预先）+ viso（看见）：预先看见并写下的条件，就是「但书」。

root: 拉丁语 proviso quod（前提是），源出 providere（预先看见、预备）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses are one small line added to a yes: a statute, a contract, a treaty, a speech, a phrase, a hidden page, a fence and a dinner invitation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都是在「好」字后面加的一行小字：一条法令、一份合同、一份条约、一段发言、一个短语、一页隐藏条款、一道围栏与一次饭局邀请。

core.en: A YES WITH A SMALL TAIL ATTACHED

branches.en: A statute and a treaty.
branches.cn: 法令与条约。

branches.en: A contract and a speech.
branches.cn: 合同与发言。

branches.en: The phrase people actually use.
branches.cn: 人们实际在用的那个短语。

branches.en: A hidden line and a fence.
branches.cn: 隐藏的一行与一道围栏。

branches.en: The loosest sense, far from court.
branches.cn: 最宽松的义项，离法庭很远。

intro.en: The providere family is about seeing ahead: provide is to supply what is foreseen, provision is the supplying, and a proviso is the condition written down in advance.
intro.cn: providere 词族关乎预先看见：provide 是供应所预见之物，provision 是供应本身，proviso 是预先写下的条件。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre supplies the seeing and pro- supplies the forward direction; providere therefore means to look ahead, and a proviso is that look written into a document.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 提供「看」，pro- 提供向前方向；因此 providere 意为向前看，而 proviso 就是那一眼被写进文书。

definition_zh: 幼稚的；孩子气的；愚蠢可笑的；（医学）儿童期特有的
definition_en: childish in a way that a grown person should have outgrown, or, of a physical sign, normal in a child and alarming in an adult
core_image: 两个穿西装的人在正式场合互相起外号
scene: 两个成年人在会上互相起外号，谁都不肯先停。Two grown men traded nicknames across the table, a puerile contest that outlasted the agenda.
sceneCN: 这里 puerile 指幼稚得可笑（第 1 个义项：成年人的幼稚）；句意为两个成年人在会上互相起外号，谁也不肯先停，这场幼稚的较劲比议程还长。

pos.zh: 幼稚的；孩子气的；愚蠢可笑的；（医学）儿童期特有的

senses.title: Childish in an adult
senses.definition: of an adult, behaving, speaking or choosing with the silliness that a child should have left behind
senses.definitionCN: 形容成年人在行为、言语或选择上带着本该丢下的孩子气
senses.example: Two grown men traded nicknames across the table, a puerile contest that outlasted the agenda.
senses.exampleCN: 两个成年人在会上互相起外号，这场幼稚的较劲比议程还长。
senses.why: The word judges the age of the actor before it judges the act.
senses.whyCN: 这个词评判的是行为者的年龄，不只是行为本身。

senses.title: Puerile breathing
senses.definition: used clinically of a physical sign that is normal in a child and abnormal if it persists in an adult
senses.definitionCN: 临床上指某种体征在儿童身上正常、成人仍有则为异常
senses.example: The physician noted puerile breathing, which in an adult patient is a warning.
senses.exampleCN: 医生记下了儿童型呼吸音，这在成年病人身上是一个警示。
senses.why: No sneer survives here: the word simply places the sign inside childhood.
senses.whyCN: 这里没有一丝嘲讽：这个词只是把这种体征归入童年。

intro.en: Puerile is simply 'boyish' in Latin: puer was the word for a boy, and the adjective kept the schoolyard in it.
intro.cn: puerile 在拉丁语里就是「男孩的」：puer 是男孩，这个形容词把校园操场留在了词里。

items.en: Puer meant 'boy or child', and it also named a young servant.
items.cn: puer 意为「男孩、孩子」，也用来称年轻的仆役。

items.en: Puerilis meant 'of a boy, boyish', a plain adjective without any insult.
items.cn: puerilis 意为「男孩的、孩子气的」，本来只是个不带侮辱的形容词。

items.en: English borrowed puerile for things proper to childhood.
items.cn: 英语借入 puerile，指属于童年的事物。

items.en: Doctors used puerile for breathing sounds that are normal in children.
items.cn: 医生用 puerile 指儿童身上正常的呼吸音。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the adjective was chiefly a criticism of adults.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，这个形容词主要是对成年人的批评。

note.en: The look-alike group is the puer family; the near-meaning group separates childish, infantile, juvenile and immature.
note.cn: 形近组是 puer 词族；近义组把「孩子气的」「婴儿般的」「少年式的」与「不成熟的」分开。

entries.definition: silly in the way a child can be.
entries.definitionCN: 以孩子的方式显得傻气的。
婴儿般的，或极不成熟的。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of two men in suits trading playground names.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「两个穿西装的人在互起操场上那种外号」的画面。

normal.en: Puerile holds puer, Latin for boy: the word is boyishness in a grown body.
normal.cn: puerile 里藏着 puer（拉丁语的男孩）：这个词是装在成人身体里的孩子气。

normal.en: Think of a boardroom that has turned into a playground.
normal.cn: 想象一间会议室变成了操场。

normal.en: Pu-er-ILE: the stress sits on ile, and the word ends like a label.
normal.cn: pu-er-ILE：重音落在 ile，词尾听起来像一个标签。

normal.en: Say PYOO-uh-ryl; the first syllable sounds like a scolding.
normal.cn: 读成 PYOO-uh-ryl，第一音节听起来像一声责骂。

normal.en: Pair it with childlike: one praises wonder, the other blames it.
normal.cn: 把它和 childlike 配对：一个称赞好奇，一个责怪好奇。

abstract.en: Puerile measures behaviour against the age of the person doing it.
abstract.cn: puerile 用行为者的年龄来衡量行为。

abstract.en: The word began as a neutral description of boyhood and became a weapon for reviewers.
abstract.cn: 这个词起初是对少年期中性的描述，后来成了评论者的武器。

abstract.en: Calling an adult puerile is a way of removing his argument without answering it.
abstract.cn: 说一个成年人幼稚，是一种不回答论证就把它拿掉的办法。

examples.en: Two grown men traded nicknames, a puerile contest that outlasted the agenda.
examples.cn: 两个成年人在互起外号，这场幼稚的较劲比议程还长。

examples.en: The physician noted puerile breathing, which in an adult patient is a warning.
examples.cn: 医生记下了儿童型呼吸音，这在成年病人身上是一个警示。

examples.en: Childlike wonder is a gift; puerile wonder is an excuse.
examples.cn: childlike 的好奇是礼物，puerile 的好奇是借口。

dict_mnemonic.text: puer（男孩）+ ile：一副男孩做派，就是「幼稚的」。

root: 拉丁语 puer（男孩、孩子）派生的 puerilis（孩子气的）

sensesIntro.en: Two senses share one root: a grown person still acting like a child, and a clinical sign that belongs to childhood alone.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项共用一个根：一个还在像孩子一样行事的成年人，以及一种只属于童年的临床体征。

core.en: AN ADULT BODY CARRYING A CHILD'S MARK
core.cn: 成人身上带着孩子的印记

chain: THE MARK OF A CHILD APPEARS

branches.en: Conduct that a grown person should have outgrown.
branches.cn: 成年人本该丢掉的行为。

branches.en: Speech and taste stuck at the playground level.
branches.cn: 停在操场水平的言语与趣味。

branches.en: The word used as a verdict on a person.
branches.cn: 这个词被用作对人的判词。

branches.en: The neutral clinical sense, where boyish means normal for a boy.
branches.cn: 中性的临床义：boyish 指对孩子而言正常。

branches.en: One root, two judgements: a sneer or a diagnosis.
branches.cn: 同一个根，两种判断：一声冷笑或一个诊断。

intro.en: The puer family is small and boyish: puerile is the adjective, puerility the noun, and puerilism the medical return to childhood.
intro.cn: puer 词族小而带男孩气：puerile 是形容词，puerility 是名词，puerilism 是退回童年的医学说法。

latinIntro.en: Latin puer supplies the boy and -ilis supplies the adjective; the word therefore says 'of a boy' before it says anything rude.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 puer 提供男孩，-ilis 提供形容词；所以这个词在说出任何贬义之前，只说了「男孩的」。

definition_zh: 磨成粉；粉碎；彻底击败
definition_en: to reduce something to powder, or to defeat it so completely that nothing is left standing
core_image: 锤子落下去，一块矿石在案上散成细灰
scene: 锤子一落，那块矿石就成了细粉。One blow of the hammer pulverized the ore into a fine dust.
sceneCN: 这里 pulverize 指把矿石粉碎成粉（第 1 个义项：磨成粉）；句意为锤子一落，那块矿石就散成了细粉。

senses.title: Grind to powder
senses.definition: to break a solid thing down into dust or powder
senses.definitionCN: 把固体打碎成灰或粉
senses.example: One blow of the hammer pulverized the ore into a fine dust.
senses.exampleCN: 锤子一落，那块矿石散成细粉。
senses.why: This is the physical sense, and every other sense copies it.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理义，其他义项都在模仿它。

senses.title: Crush rock
senses.definition: to reduce stone or ore by impact or by machine
senses.definitionCN: 用撞击或机器把石头、矿石打碎
senses.example: The mill pulverizes ten tonnes of limestone a day.
senses.exampleCN: 这家磨坊每天粉碎十吨石灰岩。
senses.why: Industry needs the word for a job done at scale.
senses.whyCN: 工业需要这个词来描述一项大规模完成的活。

senses.title: Grind food
senses.definition: to crush a dry ingredient into a fine state for cooking
senses.definitionCN: 把干性食材压成细末以供烹饪
senses.example: Pulverize the spices before adding them to the oil.
senses.exampleCN: 把香料捣碎后再放进油里。
senses.why: The kitchen sense is small and homely, and still literal.
senses.whyCN: 厨房义小而家常，而且仍是字面的。

senses.title: Rout an army
senses.definition: to defeat a force so completely that it cannot regroup
senses.definitionCN: 彻底击败一支力量，使它无法重新集结
senses.example: The cavalry pulverized the left wing before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 骑兵在正午前就击溃了左翼。
senses.why: War gives the metaphor its most concrete example.
senses.whyCN: 战争给了这个比喻最具体的例子。

senses.title: Demolish an argument
senses.definition: to answer a case so fully that no part of it remains
senses.definitionCN: 把一套论证回应到不剩任何部分
senses.example: Her reply pulverized his three main points in four sentences.
senses.exampleCN: 她的回应用四句话就驳倒了他的三个要点。
senses.why: Debate borrows the hammer, and the word makes the victory total.
senses.whyCN: 辩论借来那把锤子，这个词让胜利变得彻底。

senses.title: Break a record
senses.definition: to beat a previous mark by so much that it looks broken
senses.definitionCN: 把先前的纪录超过太多，看起来像被打碎了
senses.example: The runner pulverized the national record by nine seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 这名跑者把全国纪录缩短了九秒。
senses.why: Sport needs a verb stronger than beat.
senses.whyCN: 体育需要一个比 beat 更重的动词。

senses.title: Crush opposition
senses.definition: to remove resistance quickly and without negotiation
senses.definitionCN: 迅速且不谈判地消除抵抗
senses.example: The vote pulverized the opposition in every district.
senses.exampleCN: 那次投票在每个选区都粉碎了反对派。
senses.why: Politics uses the word when the margin is humiliating.
senses.whyCN: 当差距令人难堪时，政治就用这个词。

senses.title: Break down completely
senses.definition: to reduce a system or a feeling to nothing that can function
senses.definitionCN: 把一个系统或一种情感削到无法运作
senses.example: The scandal pulverized the trust the school had built.
senses.exampleCN: 丑闻把学校多年建立的信任击得粉碎。
senses.why: The most abstract sense is also the most final.
senses.whyCN: 最抽象的义项，也是最彻底的。

intro.en: Pulverize is 'to make dust': Latin pulvis is dust, and the verb simply asks for more of it.
intro.cn: pulverize 就是「使成尘」：拉丁语 pulvis 是灰尘，这个动词只是要求更多的灰。

items.en: Pulvis meant 'dust or powder', the word behind pulverize and pulverulent.
items.cn: pulvis 意为「灰尘、粉末」，是 pulverize 与 pulverulent 背后的词。

items.en: Late Latin pulverizare meant 'to reduce to powder'.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 pulverizare 意为「使成粉」。

items.en: English borrowed the verb for chemistry, mining and medicine.
items.cn: 英语借入这个动词，用于化学、采矿与医学。

items.en: Mills and crushers gave the word its everyday home.
items.cn: 磨坊与破碎机给了这个词日常的家。

items.en: Sport and politics later borrowed it for total victories.
items.cn: 体育与政治后来借它来表示彻底的胜利。

note.en: The look-alike group is the pulvis family; the near-meaning group separates crush, grind, smash and demolish.
note.cn: 形近组是 pulvis 词族；近义组把「压碎」「磨碎」「砸碎」与「拆毁」分开。

normalIntro.en: The hooks keep the picture of a hammer blow that leaves only grey dust on the bench.
normalIntro.cn: 以下联想留住「一锤落下，案上只剩灰粉」的画面。

normal.en: Pulverize holds pulvis, Latin for dust: the verb makes more of it.
normal.cn: pulverize 里藏着 pulvis（拉丁语的灰尘）：这个动词制造更多的灰。

normal.en: Think of a stone that leaves nothing but grey on the bench.
normal.cn: 想象一块石头，最后只在案上留下灰色。

normal.en: Pul-ver-IZE: the stress sits on pul, and the ending means 'to make'.
normal.cn: pul-ver-IZE：重音落在 pul，词尾意为「使成为」。

normal.en: Say PUL-vuh-ryze; the first syllable is as short as a hammer blow.
normal.cn: 读成 PUL-vuh-ryze，第一音节短得像一锤。

normal.en: Pair it with record: a pulverized record is one that looks broken.
normal.cn: 把它和 record 配对：被 pulverize 的纪录，看起来像被打碎了。

abstract.en: Pulverize is the strongest verb of defeat, because it leaves no pieces large enough to argue with.
abstract.cn: pulverize 是最强的击败动词，因为它不留下一块大到能反驳的碎片。

abstract.en: The image is always the same: solid becomes dust, and the word only changes the material.
abstract.cn: 意象始终如一：固体变成灰，这个词只更换材料。

abstract.en: A pulverized thing cannot be rebuilt from its parts, which is why the metaphor is so satisfying.
abstract.cn: 被粉碎之物无法由碎片重建，所以这个比喻如此解气。

examples.en: One blow of the hammer pulverized the ore into a fine dust.
examples.cn: 锤子一落，那块矿石散成细粉。

examples.en: Her reply pulverized his three main points in four sentences.
examples.cn: 她的回应用四句话就驳倒了他的三个要点。

examples.en: The scandal pulverized the trust the school had built.
examples.cn: 丑闻把学校多年建立的信任击得粉碎。

dict_mnemonic.text: pulver（粉末）+ ize（使成为）：使变成粉末，就是「粉碎、彻底击败」。

root: 拉丁语 pulvis（灰尘、粉末）派生的 pulverizare（使成粉）

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses all end in dust: ore, limestone, spice, cavalry, a three-point case, a record, an opposition and a school's trust.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项最后都落在灰里：矿石、石灰岩、香料、骑兵、三点论证、一项纪录、一支反对派与一所学校的信任。

core.en: A HAMMER BLOW THAT LEAVES ONLY DUST

branches.en: Ore, stone and spice, all ground down.
branches.cn: 矿石、石头与香料，都被磨成粉。

branches.en: A wing of cavalry that cannot regroup.
branches.cn: 无法重新集结的一翼骑兵。

branches.en: An argument and an opposition.
branches.cn: 一套论证与一支反对派。

branches.en: A record that looks broken rather than beaten.
branches.cn: 一项看起来被打碎而非被击败的纪录。

branches.en: Trust reduced to nothing that works.
branches.cn: 被削到无法运作的信任。

intro.en: The pulvis family is about powder: pulverize makes it, pulverization is the making, and a pulverizer is the machine that does the work.
intro.cn: pulvis 词族关乎粉末：pulverize 制造它，pulverization 是那个制造过程，pulverizer 是干活的机器。

latinIntro.en: Latin pulvis supplies the dust, and the suffix -izare supplies the making; English keeps the whole workshop in one verb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pulvis 提供灰尘，后缀 -izare 提供「使成为」；英语把整个作坊收进一个动词。
